IMPACT: Medium
* The HybridRouter fallback logic in core/router.py may silently fail when the primary routing mechanism is unavailable and the fallback mechanism is not properly configured.
* The exact scenario where routing silently fails is when the primary route is down and the fallback route is not correctly set up in core/config.py, causing packets to be dropped without notification.
* The impact is that packets will be lost without alerting the system administrator, potentially leading to unnoticed service disruptions.
* A suggested fix is to implement a notification system in core/logger.py to alert administrators when the primary route fails and the fallback mechanism is not operational, ensuring timely intervention to restore routing functionality.
